- Two Bible windows with different translations; windows that automatically synchronize for the current position, but can also be used independently
- Fast search of the Bible text
- Bible text: convenient paging and scrolling, categorized bookmarks
- Built-in information on the correspondence of the "Russian" and "standard" numbering of verses in the book of Psalms, Job, and Song of Solomon (this provides for parallel reading of these books in Russian and in other languages)
- Copying of selected verses, copying of verses found as a result of search

An App for reading the Holy Bible.

-Simple
-No ads
-Read offline
-Choose the book and the chapter to begin your reading.
-Quick Search System
-When selecting a text, markup options will appear in the lower right corner.
-Touch the screen with two fingers to start the auto scrolling.
